subject: Discovery recap + check on timing (ZenPort integration)
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Saanvi Rao <saanvi@zenport.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-10-05T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap + next steps (ZenPort)

Hi Saanvi — great to meet today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- Summary: ZenPort is looking to add an internal search assistant and generate short summaries from operational logs. Your priority is a POC that preserves log privacy and stays under $0.60/1k tokens.
- What we proposed: Redwood-hosted model with KV caching + prefix filtering; dedicated VPC option if you want logs never to leave your network.
- Technical open items for SE: expected average sequence length, throughput (concurrent requests), and any non-text artifacts in logs.
- Procurement: you mentioned legal wants a short data flow diagram and SOC2 evidence.

Next steps I propose: 
1) I’ll share discovery notes + a one-pager (attached).
2) Marcus — can you review the performance/throughput assumptions and call out any constraints for a POC?
3) Neha — CS: can you draft a 2-3 success metrics we can share with the customer?
4) Saanvi — let me know if timing has shifted; otherwise I’ll send a short proposal and a proposed POC timeline by EOW.

Attachments: zenport-discovery-notes.pdf, zenport-mvp-scope.xlsx

Thanks —
Laura
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: quick align before I follow up with ZenPort

Team — Saanvi hasn't replied to the recap or the proposal I sent Friday. Before I nudge, want to align on messaging and ask (~30s internal thread so I can keep the external email tight):

- Goal of the bump: check priority and propose a 30-min POC kickoff (no legal artifacts attached just yet).
- Fallback ask: if timing slipped, ask when a good window would be; offer an asynchronous technical write-up for procurement.

Marcus — key points I want to confirm from you for the external note: any blockers for a single-GPU POC, and if 8k context is safe given their log lengths?
Neha — want to use your success criteria suggestions so it's in the same language as CS playbook (uptime, mean response latency, false-summary rate).
Rishi — anything from a pricing/discount lens we should pre-approve for this touch?

I’ll hold on sending anything to Saanvi until I get your quick takes — please reply inline.

—Laura

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: quick align before I follow up with ZenPort

Laura — quick notes inline: 

- Single-GPU POC: feasible if we quantize to int8 and cap sequence length. If they have many long logs (>4k tokens), we should propose chunking + stitched summaries; that will impact latency but keeps HW cost down.
- 8k context: safe technically, but cost will rise. For POC suggest 4k context and an initial sample set from their logs to validate.
- Blockers: none from infra; need a sample log file and expected QPS to size concurrency.

I attached a small SE note (stubbed as "zenport-se-brief.txt") I can expand into a slide if you want to include a short tech appendix in the next email.

—Marcus

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T13:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: quick align before I follow up with ZenPort

Thanks Laura — Proposed success criteria (short list):

1) Summary accuracy >= 85% on a 200-sample blind test (ZenPort provides labeled highlights).
2) End-to-end mean latency < 750ms for 4k context at 1 RPS per user.
3) Cost target <= $0.60 / 1k tokens for median workload at POC scale.

Operational asks: procurement will likely request an evidence pack (SOC2, data retention policy, audit logs). I can draft the procurement-friendly summary and attach the SOC2 page link.

Happy to be on the POC kickoff to own success metrics.

—Neha
